verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents a first-party way to operate OCI itself with natural-language commands. The CLI, SDKs, REST APIs and Terraform are all structured interfaces. The official MCP server (probe-4) belongs to a separate MCP-server story and is a building block for external agents, so it is not credited here. The Select AI items describe a Java SDK and agent teams within databases, not natural-language control of the platform.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
